title: TapAuth: Raspberry Pi NFC attendance and reservation kiosk with local-first registration
description: TapAuth is a Raspberry Pi NFC attendance and reservation kiosk with local-first card registration and recognition. It keeps normal kiosk interactions usable through a durable local registry while reconciling operational data with optional MySQL and Firebase services. Usage: install the application on a Raspberry Pi with a supported NFC reader, configure local credentials, and run the kiosk service. Applications include school attendance, laboratory access logging, equipment reservations, and campus maker-space workflows.
